body: For my many friends and co-conspirators in the emergent, missional, and progressive christianity conversations … i just learned that the “early-bird” registration rate for an important gathering in October in Thailand has been extended. It’s not cheap to get there, and it’s a long flight, but if you feel called to be part of this … you’ll find more information here.
